Maya (Docs): Created a small PR consolidating runbook examples for 429s, timeouts, and context-trim fallbacks. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/499 — need quick snippets + a short user-facing copy.
Rafael (SDK): I can add Python + Go snippets for handling Retry-After and X-Redwood-Retry-Window. Where should the files live? `docs/snippets/err-ref/rate-limit/`?
Maya (Docs): That path sounds good. Please include both immediate retry-with-jitter and exponential backoff examples. Keep snippets <= 12 lines.
Priya (eng-runtime): Note: runtime emits two flavor of 429s — transient (burst) and sustained (capacity). Call out heuristics: for burst 429 prefer short jittered retries; for sustained 429 prefer fallback to quantized model or queueing. Also mention header `X-Redwood-Retry-Window` (seconds) we emit for short windows.
Jordan (QA): I'll attach a tiny repro harness with curl and a node replay script. Plan to add `docs/err-ref/examples/429-timeouts/harness-repro.md` with sanitized logs.
Anya (Product): Also flag on UX — don't dump raw server JSON to end users. Suggested microcopy: "Service busy. Please try again in a few seconds." Keep it flexible.
Rafael (SDK): Draft Python snippet: ```python
# minimal 429 handler
resp = client.generate(req)
if resp.status_code == 429:
    wait = int(resp.headers.get("Retry-After") or resp.headers.get("X-Redwood-Retry-Window", "1"))
    time.sleep(wait + random.random())
    # retry once with small jitter
```
Maya (Docs): Nice. Can you also add the Node/TS example and a tiny comment about parsing `Retry-After` values which can be seconds or HTTP-date?
Priya (eng-runtime): Good call — add a note: prefer parsing numeric seconds first, then fall back to date parsing. Also document that `Retry-After` is optional and runtime may only send `X-Redwood-Retry-Window` for very short windows.
Jordan (QA): Uploading harness now. It contains: curl commands that trigger context-limit -> timeout, example logs, and a tiny replay script. I'll sanitize API keys.
Maya (Docs): Great — please include a one-paragraph summary at top of the harness file explaining what the repro shows and expected behavior.
Rafael (SDK): PR updated with Python/Go/Node snippets, structured under `docs/snippets/err-ref/rate-limit/`. Also added small note about Retry-After parsing and header precedence. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/499/files
docs-bot: Label added: err-ref, needs-sdk-review
Anya (Product): Quick UX tweak: shorten microcopy to "Try again in a few seconds." Approved.
Maya (Docs): Thanks all. I'll do a final pass on wording and merge after one more runtime + SDK approval. Ping me if you want to pair on the tiny diagram that explains fallback ordering.
